title: Touchline historical FPL data dictionary and domain rules
purpose: Codify the data meanings, allowed categories, identities, units, aggregation rules and validation coverage used by the current historical research agent.
important_limit: This file documents and classifies the domain. Only explicitly identified portions are read by the runtime; the descriptions do not execute themselves. Results live in dated verification reports, not static PASS labels here.

terminology.taxonomy: Controlled categories such as positions, field categories and ranking metrics.
terminology.domain_model: Players, fixtures, gameweeks, measurements and their identities, relationships and aggregation rules.
terminology.agent_codification: This file describes the data contract. Workflow, action validation and model instructions remain in the agent specification and Python POLICY.
terminology.versioning: The dictionary edition is independent of the app release.

active_agent.scope: Historical player research, not a transfer recommender or squad evaluator.
active_agent.model_context: The model receives the runtime POLICY, snapshot metadata, user question and tool observations. This whole JSON and the raw CSV are not automatically inserted into each model request.

evidence_scope.active_frame: Included fingerprinted CSV, byte-matched to the pinned upstream source in results/data_provenance.json.
evidence_scope.source_provenance: Vaastav Anand / Fantasy-Premier-League; pinned source and MIT licence recorded in results/data_provenance.json and data/LICENSE.
evidence_scope.coverage_limit: The app validates the research inputs; broader semantics of unused source fields are not all enforced.

row_model.observation_unit: One player-fixture record within the configured season, including zero-minute records.
row_model.season_instruction: Season comes from app/config.json; do not join across seasons without a verified identity mapping.
row_model.double_gameweek_rule: Different fixtures in one gameweek are distinct observations and must be aggregated, not deduplicated.
row_model.duplicate_rule: Compare full rows. Remove fully identical copies only; reject conflicting player-fixture keys.
row_model.blank_gameweek_rule: No fixture row is not an observed zero. Under the current reporting convention, a known player with a prior record but no interval rows receives zero interval totals and a warning; a player first recorded after interval end has unavailable totals and prices.
relationships: A fixture is assigned a gameweek.
A player can have multiple fixture records in the same gameweek.
Recorded price and club context belong to a dated fixture row.

query_contract.intervals: Inclusive start_gameweek and end_gameweek OR trailing window_gameweeks; never both.
query_contract.price_rule: Latest recorded row at or before interval end; return price_gameweek and warn if stale. Not a live or verified deadline price.
query_contract.clarification_policy: The model policy asks for missing shortlist position/budget and ambiguous or unsupported scope; this is an instruction, not a complete deterministic natural-language parser.
query_contract.controller_contract: Only allowlisted JSON actions execute. Comparison IDs must first be observed. See the Python controller for action validation, period protection and loop limits.

player_identity.label: Who the player is
player_identity.default_timing: Historical identity; verify season and team at the observation date.

fixture_context.label: Which match and gameweek
fixture_context.default_timing: Historical fixture and gameweek context. Final scores are observed post-match; this file does not establish deadline-time availability.
fixture_context.default_aggregation: Group or join; do not sum identifiers or repeated scores.

participation.label: Whether and how much the player played

expected_and_ict.label: Expected statistics and performance indices
expected_and_ict.default_timing: Post-match measures except xP, whose collection timing is uncertain.
expected_and_ict.default_aggregation: Metric-specific; xP must not be summed over repeated fixture rows.

market.label: Price, ownership and transfers
market.default_aggregation: For current historical prices, select the latest recorded fixture row at/before query end; never sum prices. Other market fields are unused and need verified timing before use.

name.note: Use element with season for joins; names can change or collide.

position.note: Raw FPL categories include all four positions. The research tools support MID/FWD only; do not narrow the raw-file schema to the app subset.

team.description: Club name recorded for this row.
team.note: Not a numeric team ID; club membership can change over time.

xP.description: Provider expected-points value, distinct from actual points.
xP.timing: Unverified; exclude from prediction inputs by default.
xP.aggregation: Do not sum across fixtures in the same gameweek.
xP.note: A matching public dataset documents an ep_this snapshot with possible post-match contamination. Confirm the actual supplier and collection time. Do not assume it was visible before the deadline.

assists.description: Assists credited under FPL rules in this fixture.
assists.note: FPL assist awards can differ from other football data providers.

bonus.description: Bonus points awarded for this fixture.
bonus.note: Already included in total_points; do not add twice.

bps.note: Used to determine bonus awards; not itself FPL points. Negative values are possible.

clean_sheets.description: Clean-sheet credit recorded for the player in this fixture.
clean_sheets.note: FPL eligibility includes playing-time rules. A team shutout does not guarantee every player receives this credit.

creativity.description: ICT measure of chances created for others.
creativity.aggregation: Sum valid fixture-level values only when a total is intended.

element.note: Scope to the season; do not assume IDs match across seasons.

expected_assists.description: Model-based expected assist contribution in this fixture.
expected_assists.aggregation: Sum across distinct fixtures; not a pre-match forecast.

expected_goal_involvements.description: Combined expected goal and assist contribution.
expected_goal_involvements.relationship: Approximately expected_goals + expected_assists, allowing independent rounding.
expected_goal_involvements.note: Retained source field. Active xgi_per90 is computed from summed expected_goals plus expected_assists, not this independently rounded column.

expected_goals.description: Shot-quality-based expected scoring contribution in this fixture.
expected_goals.aggregation: Sum across distinct fixtures; not a pre-match forecast.

expected_goals_conceded.description: Expected concession measure attributed to this player.
expected_goals_conceded.note: Confirm whether the supplier uses only the player's on-pitch exposure. Do not equate it with the final opposition score.

fixture.note: Within-season match ID. Different fixture IDs in one gameweek must remain separate.

goals_conceded.description: Goals conceded during the player's relevant on-pitch exposure.
goals_conceded.note: Can differ from the team's full-match goals conceded.

goals_scored.description: Goals credited to the player in this fixture.

ict_index.description: Combined Influence, Creativity and Threat performance measure.
ict_index.aggregation: Use provider index values; verify scaling before recomputing.

influence.description: ICT measure of the player's impact on the match.
influence.aggregation: Sum valid fixture-level values only when a total is intended.

kickoff_time.note: Parse as timezone-aware ISO 8601. Z means UTC. A current schedule can differ from the schedule known before a historical deadline.

minutes.note: Review unusual values against supplier conventions rather than silently capping them.

modified.description: Supplier flag indicating a changed or corrected record.
modified.note: Exact trigger is unverified. False does not establish that the record is correct.

opponent_team.note: Requires a season-specific team-ID lookup. Do not guess club names from two examples.

own_goals.description: Own goals charged to the player.

penalties_missed.description: Missed penalties charged to the player.

penalties_saved.description: Penalty saves credited to the player.

round.note: Matches GW in the supplied rows. Check equality over the full file before treating it as redundant.

saves.description: Goalkeeper saves recorded in the fixture.

selected.description: Number of FPL managers owning the player at the recorded snapshot.
selected.note: This is an absolute count, not a percentage. Ownership percentage requires a compatible total-manager denominator.

starts.description: Whether the player was in the starting lineup.
starts.note: Zero can mean substitute appearance or no appearance. minutes > 0 with starts = 0 is valid.

team_a_score.timing: Post-match result in completed historical fixtures; null may mean unplayed.
team_a_score.note: The away club is not necessarily the player's opponent.

team_h_score.timing: Post-match result in completed historical fixtures; null may mean unplayed.

threat.description: ICT measure of the player's scoring threat.
threat.aggregation: Sum valid fixture-level values only when a total is intended.

total_points.description: Actual FPL points credited for this player-fixture row.
total_points.note: Can be negative. Confirm fixture-level scope before aggregating; season tables can use the same label for a season total.

transfers_balance.description: Net transfers over the supplier's reporting interval.
transfers_balance.note: Signed quantity. Verify whether the supplier reports gameweek activity and how snapshots behave in double gameweeks.

transfers_in.description: Transfers bringing the player into managers' squads.
transfers_in.note: Commonly gameweek activity in player-history files; verify the reporting interval and snapshot cutoff.

transfers_out.description: Transfers removing the player from managers' squads.
transfers_out.note: Commonly gameweek activity in player-history files; verify the reporting interval and snapshot cutoff.

value.description: FPL purchase price recorded at the snapshot.
value.note: Recorded fixture-row price, selected at/before the query end. Not a live price or a verified deadline-time market snapshot.

was_home.description: Whether the player's club was the home side.
was_home.note: False means the player's club was away.

yellow_cards.description: Yellow cards recorded for the player.
yellow_cards.note: Do not impose a red/yellow arithmetic relation without checking the supplier's booking conventions.

clearances_blocks_interceptions.note: The three components are not supplied separately.

defensive_contribution.note: Treat as an action count, not awarded FPL points. Verify its position-dependent relationship to clearances_blocks_interceptions, tackles and recoveries before recomputing.

GW.note: Gameweek label used for inclusive historical query bounds. The loader checks agreement with round.

parsing_policy.numbers: Strict finite numeric parsing for active measurements; integer fields have no fractional part. Do not convert spreadsheet-looking dates into guessed decimals.
parsing_policy.required_loader_values: Invalid required GW, IDs, minutes, points, price, round/position consistency or nonblank xG/xA values reject loading; do not repair raw data.
parsing_policy.missing_measurements: Blank xG/xA may survive loading; the affected tool aggregate and derived rate are unavailable, not zero-imputed.
parsing_policy.zero_minutes: Per-90 metrics are null when minutes are zero.
parsing_policy.empty_interval: Use the explicit known-player convention in row_model; do not confuse an absent row with an observed measurement.
parsing_policy.timestamps: The runtime orders kickoff_time strings. The separate contract verifier checks explicit UTC parsing; this is not an extra loader-enforced datetime parser.
parsing_policy.unused_fields: Retain original columns and tokens. Full parsing and semantic checks are required before newly using an inactive column; unused numeric/boolean rules are not all enforced by the current loader.
parsing_policy.schema_drift: Reject a column-order/schema mismatch rather than silently dropping columns.

validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.rule: round equals GW and raw positions belong to the source categories
validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.rule: Nonblank xG/xA inputs must be finite and nonnegative; blank values propagate unavailable aggregates
validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

validation_checks.result_location: Dated runtime comparison reports under results/; no static pass/fail verdict here.

derived_fields.name: points
derived_fields.note: Already includes awarded scoring components; do not add goals, assists or bonus again.

known_limits: No live data source or prediction model.
Recorded prices have unverified deadline collection timing.
Unused source columns retain provisional supplier definitions.
agent_use_instructions: Read the dictionary before loading the CSV.
Use source-column definitions and units; distinguish the raw position categories from the narrower research scope.
Keep workflow and model instructions authoritative in app/agent_spec.md and the Python POLICY.
Do not treat descriptive xG/xA or observed points as future forecasts.
Validate executable coverage using verification/check_data_contract.py and the existing data checks.
Write new verification evidence to results/local; retain results/example.json as the recorded demo.
